name: 02186 · Milton, MA
findings: ZIP 02186 (Milton) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02186 (Milton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02186 (Milton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02186 (Milton) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do education organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
